issues.issue: Could the Board find serious non-political crime from charges or conduct without a conviction for that crime?
issues.applicant_position: Board should not rely on an uncharged assault; the conviction was only a misdemeanour and the Board speculated about the prosecutor.
issues.result_quote: It is not constrained by the exact characterization of the conviction, or whether there was any conviction at all.

issues.issue: Did the Board reasonably assess the seriousness of the crime under Jayasekara in the Canadian context?
issues.applicant_position: A misdemeanour is not equivalent to a Canadian summary offence; the Board did not assess the factors properly.
issues.result_quote: I cannot find that the Board erred by looking at the gravity of the underlying incident

issues.issue: Is a serious non-political crime limited to human-rights-type crimes under Ward and Pushpanathan?
issues.applicant_position: Only crimes related to human rights give rise to exclusion under Ward and Pushpanathan.
issues.respondent_position: No specifics were provided to support this argument.
issues.result_quote: With respect, this is not the case.
